models.description: Quarterly and Reg Season forecasts estimate team scoring ability from Potential PPG using Empirical-Bayes estimates trained on normalized seasons beginning in 2018. The simulations include Normal weekly scoring variation and week-specific uncertainty about team strength. Bonus Games and Playoffs share these Bonus Game forecasts.
